name: yes2sdk
description: One integration ships your HTML5 game to every supported web game platform. Install once, and Codex knows the whole SDK.

interface.longDescription: Registers the hosted Yes2SDK MCP server and adds skills that install the SDK in Unity, Defold or JavaScript/TypeScript (Phaser, three.js, vanilla) projects, scaffold the unified init and ad loop, verify a build against Poki, CrazyGames, Yandex Games, GameDistribution, YouTube Playables and Jest rules, diagnose integration failures, and upload a build to the Yes2 dashboard once you sign in with your dashboard account.
defaultPrompt: Set up Yes2SDK in this project
Verify my WebGL build in ./build against every platform
My rewarded ad plays but the reward never lands
